The Knights were members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. The Knights, in the program's 48th season of basketball, were led by first-year head coach [[Johnny Dawkins]] and played their home games at the [[CFE Arena]] on the university's main campus in [[Orlando, Florida|Orlando]], [[Florida]]. They finished the season 24–12, 11–7 in AAC play to finish in fourth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2016–17 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]]. They were invited to the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]], [[2016–17 Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball team|Illinois State]] and [[2016–17 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] to advance to the semifinals at [[Madison Square Garden]] for the first time in school history where they lost to the eventual NIT Champion, [[2016–17 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 UCF Knights men's basketball team|Knights]] finished the season with a record of 12–18, 6–12 in [[2015–16 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in seventh place in conference. They lost in the first round of the [[2016 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2015–16 Tulane Green Wave men's basketball team|Tulane]]. After the season, [[Donnie Jones (basketball)|Donnie Jones]] was fired as UCF's head coach.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/14947952/ucf-knights-fire-coach-donnie-jones-12-18-season|title=UCF ousts Jones after six seasons, 100-88 mark|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2016-06-08}} On March 24, 2016, the school hired Johnny Dawkins as head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2016/03/24/ucf-introduces-johnny-dawkins-as-new-mens-basketball-coach/82206558/|title=UCF introduces Johnny Dawkins as new men's basketball coach|newspaper=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-02-20|language=en}} ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
